newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks extend gains after U.S. jobs data.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks extend gains after U.S. jobs data.

text.p: Madrid stocks continued on their upward trend on Thursday, setting record closing highs.
The market was supported by strong gains on Wall Street after favourable U.S. economic data released on Thursday, dealers said.
"U.S. data announced in the afternoon pulled the bourse higher, especially in banking stocks," a dealer in Madrid said.

A modest rise of 217,000 in U.S. non-farm payrolls reduced expectations of an August Fed rate hike, dealers said. * General Index climbed 6.94 points, or 1.12 pct, to 625.30 * Ibex-35 advanced 79.46 , or 1.12 pct, to 7,714.41
Trading volume was higher than on Wednesday, dealers said, with 127.37 billion pesetas changing hands.
Endesa fell 80 pesetas to 13,130 pesetas, in an expected correction after powering ahead in recent sessions.
Telefonica gained 50 to 4,490 pesetas, while Repsol added 120 to 6,550 pesetas.
The banking sector outperformed both indices with BCH adding 3.9 percent, while Banesto, Argentaria and Santander climbed two percent higher.
